title: Temp4Boost
description: A customizable boost shop plugin that allows players to buy temporary potion effects using in-game currency.
body:
# ⚖️ Temp4Boost — Advanced Temporary Boost Shop

A simple and powerful temporary boost shop plugin for Minecraft servers.

Temp4Boost lets you create custom potion-based boosts with durations, prices and clean GUI menus, giving your players a flexible and engaging way to enhance gameplay.

---

## ✨ Core Features

- **GUI shop system:** Category-based menus with safe browsing, confirmation screens and permission-aware visibility  
- **Timed boosts:** Custom potion effects with configurable levels, duration, pricing, icons and layout  
- **Safety system:** Cooldowns, max active boosts, category limits, same-effect protection and anti-exploit checks  
- **Safe reload:** Prevents broken states and keeps a safe runtime if config fails  
- **Persistence:** Boosts are saved and restored across restart, relog and respawn  
- **Live HUD:** ActionBar rotation with boost name and remaining time  
- **Player command:** `/t4b active` to view active boosts  
- **Customization:** GUI, sounds, messages, layouts, categories and products  
- **Permissions:** Per-category and per-product access with flexible visibility  
- **Head support:** Items or custom heads (owner, Base64 or URL)  
- **Color support:** Legacy and RGB/Hex formats  
- **Update checker:** Optional version check  
- **PlaceholderAPI support:** Raw and display placeholders  

---

## 🚀 Advanced Systems

- Configurable stacking modes  
- Same-effect protection  
- Anti-exploit GUI checks  
- Self-healing system (effect resync)  
- Environment restrictions (worlds / creative mode)  
- Milk and death behavior control  
- Illegal amplifier protection (>255)  

---

## 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Integration

Temp4Boost includes both **raw** and **display-ready** placeholders.

### Core

| Placeholder | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `%temp4boost_active_count%` | Active boosts |
| `%temp4boost_has_<id>%` | Check boost |
| `%temp4boost_timeleft_<id>%` | Remaining time |
| `%temp4boost_list%` | Boost list |

### Display

| Placeholder | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `%temp4boost_has_any%` | Has any boost |
| `%temp4boost_next_boost%` | Next boost |
| `%temp4boost_next_time%` | Next time |
| `%temp4boost_list_display%` | Formatted list |
| `%temp4boost_status%` | Compact status |

---

## ⚙️ Commands

### Alias

| Command | Description |
|--------|------------|
| `/t4b` | Main command |
| `/temp4boost` | Alias |
| `/boostshop` | Config alias |


### Usage

| Command | Description |
|--------|------------|
| `/t4b reload` | Reload config |
| `/t4b active` | Show boosts |
| `/t4b give <player> <boostId>` | Give boost |
| `/t4b remove <player> <boostId>` | Remove boost |
| `/t4b clear <player>` | Clear boosts |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|------------|
| `temp4boost.use` | Open GUI |
| `temp4boost.active` | Active command |
| `temp4boost.admin` | Admin commands |
| `temp4boost.give` | Give boosts |
| `temp4boost.category.<category_id>` | Category access |
| `temp4boost.product.<category_id>.<product_id>` | Product access |
| `temp4boost.category.*` | All categories |
| `temp4boost.product.*` | All products |

---

## 🎯 Use Cases

- Survival servers  
- PvP servers  
- Minigames  
- Custom progression systems  

---

## 💻 Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.18 → 1.21.x  
- Java: 17 or higher  
- Platforms: Paper / Spigot  

---

## ❤️ Designed for Stability

Temp4Boost is built to be safe and reliable, with strong protection against invalid states and exploit scenarios.
